spec.title: Add global actions section to VSCode extension
spec.context: The kanban-map-product and kanban-map-engineering commands currently have no UI access in VSCode. Users must use the command palette to find and run them. Adding a "Global Actions" section to the sidebar provides discoverability and maintains a consistent visual workflow alongside the task list.

in-scope.item: New TreeView section "Global Actions" in the sidebar
Collapsible group containing flat action items
Two actions: "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs"
Each action opens terminal and runs corresponding claude command

out-of-scope.item: File watching or refresh (actions are static)

requirements.requirement: The system shall display a "Global Actions" view in the Kanban sidebar container below the Config view
The Global Actions view shall contain a collapsible "Global Actions" group item that is expanded by default
When expanded, the group shall display two flat action items: "Map Product Docs" and "Map Engineering Docs"
Each action item shall display an appropriate ThemeIcon (book for Product, symbol-structure for Engineering)
Clicking "Map Product Docs" shall open a terminal and execute: claude "/kanban-map-product"
Clicking "Map Engineering Docs" shall open a terminal and execute: claude "/kanban-map-engineering"
Action items shall be activatable via Enter key when focused (native TreeView behavior)

files.file: New capability following config-view pattern with GlobalActionsGroupItem and GlobalActionItem classes
Import and initialize global-actions-view capability, register TreeView, wire up terminal for actions
Add kanbanGlobalActions view to contributes.views.kanban array

patterns.pattern: Follow createConfigViewCapability structure: factory function returning createTreeDataProvider and createRefreshCallback Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/config-view.capability.ts:46-76
Create GlobalActionsGroupItem (collapsible) and GlobalActionItem (non-collapsible) classes extending vscode.TreeItem Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:16-57
Use new vscode.ThemeIcon('iconName') for icons, no hardcoded colors needed for these items Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/config-view.capability.ts:13
Reuse terminal capability pattern: createFreshTerminal, showTerminal, sendCommand Reference: apps/vscode/src/extension.ts:249-253

product.doc: Current sidebar has Tasks and Config views; Global Actions adds third view below these
Terminal capability creates fresh terminal per action using claude "/kanban-{command}" pattern

engineering.doc: Three-layer architecture: Orchestrator, Capabilities, Computers. New view is a Capability.

codebase.finding: config-view.capability.ts provides minimal capability pattern for simple TreeViews
package.json views array order determines sidebar display order
No file watcher needed since actions are static

pitfalls.pitfall: Must follow claude "/kanban-{command}" pattern for terminal commands
TreeView keyboard accessibility is automatic - no extra work needed

constraints.constraint: Must use VSCode ThemeIcons only (design directive C4)
Capability cannot import other capabilities (architecture directive V2)
All exported functions must have explicit return types (typescript directive C2)
New module must use .capability.ts suffix (architecture directive C3)

internal.dep: terminal.capability.ts - for running commands in terminal

risk.mitigation: Static action list, no runtime changes

risks.risk: Future actions may need to be added - currently hardcoded
